description: Two chain-held result rounds of the tip, as a node signs them (sidecar-core pipeline steps 13 and 14 with state mode chain), process_result rebuilds and verifies them (noir/pss_public_contract result.nr) and apply logs them, each with its public-input array; and two init rounds' public-input arrays. Written by sidecar-tip tests/write_vectors; read by sidecar-tip's own tests (the machine's readers of both layouts), sidecar-core tests/vectors.rs, pss-client test/vectors.test.ts and testvectors/noir/tip_result_vectors.

init_rounds.name: amm_init_tip's shape: one slot key created, no init inputs, no new leaf hashes
lending_init's shape: one tree-valued key created, one init input, its header's new leaf hash

rounds.name: n = 2: one chain-held output of two shared elements, one old commitment
n = 3: one chain-held output of three shared elements (7, p - 1, 0), two old commitments, one pinned read

rules.ids: inputs_hash = poseidon2(inputs); chain_request_id = poseidon2([namespace, vk_hash, inputs_hash, user_nonce]); machine_request_id = poseidon2([PSS_ATTEMPT, chain_request_id, old_commitments..., reads...]), reads the pinned public read values in public_reads order (chain_request_id.json)
rules.init_public_inputs: an init round's public-input array, pss_public_contract init.nr init_public_inputs: [namespace, vk_hash, out_slots[W], request_id, 0 (W times), new_commitments[W], npk_app_hash, new_hashes[H]], request_id the init chain request id chain_request_id(namespace, vk_hash, inputs, 0) and the machine request id over W old commitments of 0; init_rounds[0] has amm_init_tip's shape, init_rounds[1] lending_init's
rules.message: poseidon2([RESULT_DOMAIN, namespace, machine_request_id, new_commitments..., i, H(sealed_i)]); the signed request id is the machine request id, not the chain request id
rules.public_inputs: a round's public-input array in the non-secret-shared layout, pss_public_contract result.nr proved_public_inputs: [namespace, vk_hash, in_slots[R], out_slots[W], reads[Q], request_id, old_commitments[R], new_commitments[W], npk_app_hash, ok, app_outputs[A]], request_id the chain request id; layout gives each part's index (or indices); rounds[0] has amm_swap_tip's shape (R = W = 1, Q = 0, A = 2)
rules.public_log: Aztec v6 protocol types constants.nr: every public log of a transaction, behind its header of header_fields (length, contract address), shares one payload of payload_fields (FLAT_PUBLIC_LOGS_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, PUBLIC_LOG_HEADER_LENGTH), so one log carries at most max_log_fields = payload_fields - header_fields (MAX_PUBLIC_LOG_SIZE_IN_FIELDS)
rules.register: REGISTER's chain-held size bound (sidecar-tip chain_state::apply_log_fields): the sealed-thirds log of one apply, log_fields = 1 (tag) + writes (new commitments) + sealed_thirds_fields, where an output of len elements takes 9·len + 15 = 3 · (3·len + 5) fields of thirds (chain_state::sealed_thirds_fields), summed over the chain_outputs; accepted when log_fields is at most public_log.max_log_fields
rules.sealed_hash: H(sealed_i) = poseidon2([record_hash of node i's third]), a one-element list: one chain-held output
rules.sealed_log: the log apply emits: tag = compute_log_tag(chain_request_id, PSS_STATE); body = new_commitments[0..W] then sealed[0][0..T], sealed[1][0..T], sealed[2][0..T] (node by node, output by output), each third its L = 3·len + 5 fields; here W = T = 1, so 1 + 3L fields after the tag (sidecar-tip chain_state::SealedLog)
rules.signature: Schnorr over Grumpkin (noir-lang/schnorr v0.4.0) by node i's sig key of keys.json, {s: [lo, hi], e: [lo, hi]}; nonce derived as in results.json (label "sidecar.result_nonce")
rules.thirds: node i's third of the round's one chain-held output, sealed for node i itself: owner = node i's enc_pk, key the request key string, note_hash the output's new commitment; plaintext, nonce, ciphertext, tag and c as in records.json, under K_i of keys.json; fields = [key id as an integer, ciphertext..., tag], the form process_result's sealed argument and the log carry; record_hash = poseidon2(fields)
